name: berean-luke
description: English glosses of the Berean Interlinear Bible for Luke, word by word over the Nestle 1904 Greek text. One translator's renderings: a source of accepted glosses, not a verdict. Verses whose word count differs from the evaluated edition are skipped and reported.
license: Public domain: the Berean texts were dedicated to the public domain on 30 April 2023 (https://berean.bible/terms.htm); the dedication names 'The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts' and does not name the interlinear explicitly
citation: The Holy Bible, Berean Interlinear Bible (Bible Hub, 2016), glosses as extracted in biblicalhumanities/Nestle1904
